quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: Roads become very slippery:

options.text: When it has been raining for an hour or more.
For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
Right after the rain has stopped.

questions.correctAnswerText: For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
questions.explanation: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain, the road becomes very slippery. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. This problem gets worse in hot weather because heat makes more oil rise to the road.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to allow approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to get out of your way.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
Can disregard any pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
questions.explanation: You must stop before entering the street from a driveway. Only go when no vehicles or pedestrians are coming. Stop before you cross the sidewalk area. Not stopping is against the law.

questions.question: You are legally considered to be driving under the influence if your blood alcohol content (BAC) is at least:
questions.explanation: Drivers age 21 and older are considered to be driving under the influence if their BAC is 0.08 percent or higher. If your driving is impaired, you can be convicted even if your BAC is lower. Drivers under 21 can be convicted if their BAC is 0.02 percent or higher.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses the street carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road as the driver.
If the pedestrian uses a hand signal to ask oncoming drivers to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses the street carelessly.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always yield to pedestrians in the street. This is true even if they cross against a red light or are being careless.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down before turning. Use a speed that lets you control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and react to surprises.

questions.question: When you see a school bus with flashing red lights and a stop sign extended, you must stop and stay stopped until:

options.text: The bus driver signals you to pass.
All children are clear of the roadway and the bus moves again.

questions.correctAnswerText: All children are clear of the roadway and the bus moves again.
questions.explanation: You must stop for school buses with flashing red lights and a stop sign from any direction. Stay stopped until all children are clear of the road and the bus moves. Stop even if the lights are off when the bus is loading or unloading.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Be extra careful and slow down because wet pavement makes vehicles harder to control.

questions.question: Hydroplaning is usually caused by:
questions.explanation: As your speed increases, your tires clear water from the road less effectively. If you drive too fast, your tires lose grip and slide on a layer of water. This is called hydroplaning.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, pay attention, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: The DMV can deny or suspend driving privileges for people under 18 if they are found:

options.text: Involved in an alcohol or drug-related offense.

questions.explanation: If you are convicted of a traffic violation when under 18, the DMV will require you to complete a driver improvement clinic. If you do not complete it within 90 days, your driving privilege will be suspended until you finish the clinic and pay a reinstatement fee.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public highway:

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol while on a public road or sidewalk. You also cannot keep an open alcohol container in the areas where the driver or passenger sits.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: When you plan to turn, signal ____ before turning.
questions.explanation: Signal 100 feet (three to four seconds) before you turn.

questions.question: Another driver is passing your car. You should:

options.text: Signal when it is safe for them to pass.
Look for oncoming traffic and slow down to let them pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for oncoming traffic and slow down to let them pass safely.
questions.explanation: Stay in the right lane when another car passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed so the passing vehicle can return to the right lane easily.

questions.question: There may be times when 10 mph is too fast to safely drive.
questions.explanation: Drive below the posted speed limit when needed for safety. Bad traffic, weather, or visibility may require you to drive as slowly as 10 miles per hour.

questions.question: Drivers entering an interstate from an entrance ramp must:

options.text: Turn around if another vehicle is in the lane.
Yield to traffic already on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to traffic already on the highway.
questions.explanation: When entering an interstate from an entrance ramp, you must yield the right-of-way to traffic already on the highway.

questions.question: A driver who goes much slower than the speed limit:

options.text: Should not let other cars pass.

questions.explanation: Driving slower than surrounding traffic can be hazardous. On a two-lane road, if you drive so slowly that traffic backs up behind you, you must pull over and let them pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when conditions require it.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
You do not have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does an "End school zone" sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a reduced speed zone.
There may be more pedestrians ahead.
You are leaving a reduced speed zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are leaving a reduced speed zone.
questions.explanation: The "End school zone" sign tells you that the reduced school speed zone has ended. You can now drive at normal speeds.

questions.question: If a bus signals to enter the roadway after stopping, what should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to let them know you are there.
Speed up to pass the bus.

questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that is signaling to return to the roadway. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to let the bus enter traffic safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road is joining from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: If your turn signals do not work, how should you signal a turn?
questions.explanation: If your turn signals do not work, use hand signals to show other drivers when you are turning.

questions.question: What is true about driving on a wet road?

options.text: As you drive faster, your tires grip the road less.
Water does not affect cars with good tires.
Deep water is safer than shallow water.
Slowing down makes the road more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: As you drive faster, your tires grip the road less.
questions.explanation: As you drive faster on wet roads, your tires lose their grip on the road. If you go too fast, your tires will slide on the water instead of gripping the road. This is called hydroplaning.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass, even if it is dangerous.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Drive the same way as on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. Your car will need more time to stop.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop and block the emergency vehicle.
Do everything you can to clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
Signal when it is safe for the emergency vehicle to pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do everything you can to clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, make a clear path for it. If it is safe, pull to the side of the road to let it pass.

questions.question: In fog, should you use high beam headlights to see better?
questions.explanation: Do not use high beams in fog. Use low beams or fog lights instead.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing?
questions.explanation: Slow down, look for a train, and be ready to stop. If red lights flash or the gate is down, stop 15 to 50 feet before the tracks. Do not go around the gate.
